image.site_layer: The measured containers ran a local child image (ID sha256:c57f939fde8ca5d7134f20ec1da6a16321dd023e662ce2392d94e14390de71a1) that adds one 54 MB layer written by the image's own `verify` entrypoint action on top of this reference. The overlay files below are bind-mounted at launch and are not part of any image.
image.entrypoint_bypass: The image entrypoint attests site-packages hashes and rejects overlays, so the launchers exec `/opt/venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main serve` from a login shell (/etc/shinit_v2 activates the bundled CUDA forward-compatibility driver).

model.dflash_config_note: Revisions before b2674c72176d008cb675a09f626f8eba3f3f21c4 ship dflash/config.json with a trailing comma; the launchers mount a corrected copy (fix_dflash_config.py) when the checkpoint's file does not parse. config.json, model.safetensors.index.json and the draft weights are unchanged across those revisions.

overlay/mimo_v2.py.content: Image file plus upstream vLLM PR 57508 (fused fp8 QKV sharding by the checkpoint's pre-shard count) and PR 57784 (bf16 MoE router via GateLinear); DiffKV attention path.

overlay/mimo_v2_padded_v.py.content: As mimo_v2.py, with V zero-padded from 128 to 192 so the target runs the symmetric TRITON_ATTN kernel; VLLM_MIMO_PAD_V and VLLM_MIMO_PASS_CACHE_CONFIG switches.

overlay/mimo_v2_mtp.py.content: Image file plus PR 57508 and PR 57784.

overlay/mimo_v2_omni.py.content: Image file plus the PR 57784 SupportsEagle3 mixin (the build resolves this checkpoint to the omni class and DFlash needs Eagle3 auxiliary states).

overlay/mimo_v2_omni_mm.py.content: As mimo_v2_omni.py, plus get_mm_lora_token_counts and get_mm_mapping (the b12x eager warmup otherwise receives None for the encoder row count) and the window-attention sink slice fix for --mm-encoder-tp-mode data.

overlay/qwen3_dflash.py.content: Image file plus the PR 57784 draft attention_value_scale and a tolerant import of ModelOptMxFp8LinearMethod, which this build's modelopt module lacks; the bf16 draft never takes the MXFP8 path.

overlay/triton_unified_attention.py.content: Image kernel with the PR 839 2D/3D dispatch rule ported to the symmetric kernel: DFlash verification batches (1 + draft-length query rows per request) take the split-KV decode path.

overlay/triton_unified_attention_diffkv..content: local-inference-lab/vllm PR 839: multi-row speculative verification batches take the split-KV decode path in the DiffKV kernel; kernel arithmetic unchanged.
